name: CERN six-layer toroidal coordinate model
status: user-defined conceptual topology, not CERN magnet or beam-control layout

radial_layers.label: counter-rotating directions
radial_layers.meaning: clockwise / counterclockwise as an analytical pair; neither a map of actual bunches nor independent ATLAS coils

radial_layers.label: principal LHC detectors
radial_layers.meaning: ATLAS, ALICE, CMS, LHCb at LHC Points 1, 2, 5, 8

radial_layers.label: strength tiers
radial_layers.meaning: weak, medium, strong: abstract classifier, not calibrated physical fields or forces

radial_layers.label: shared accelerator
radial_layers.meaning: one LHC ring; CERN also hosts other accelerators

radial_layers.label: institutional enclosure
radial_layers.meaning: CERN as organizational umbrella; not one physical toroid

projection: Each of 576 possible coordinate tuples (coil_slot,direction,experiment,tier,LHC,CERN) is a *logical address* only. Slot R0 at ALICE is not an ALICE coil; experimentally coupled mappings require separately sourced observations.

encoding.physical_disclaimer: Binary state labels do not represent real currents or magnetic memory bits.

invariants: only ATLAS toroids are physical referents to 24 positions
